responsibility: Implements the whole-function execution half of GCC’s legacy reload pass. Using reload requirements produced by reload.c, it scans RTL, manages reload and spill registers, performs spilling and inheritance of reload values, emits the actual load/store and autoincrement fixup insns around constrained instructions, updates reg_renumber-related state, and iterates until invalid allocations are repaired. This file is the operational driver and code generator for old reload, as opposed to reload.c’s per-insn requirement analysis.
